articles.title: A viral SIP myth is fooling investors. Here's why
articles.summary: A viral post claims SIPs delivered just 6.7% over two decades. But the calculation is flawed—and the flat market it cites is precisely when SIPs quietly do their best work.

articles.title: Bank holidays this week: SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB to remain closed for upto 3 days — RBI calendar here
articles.summary: Bank holidays this week: Banks in India will be closed for upto three days this week, but digital platforms like UPI and banking apps will remain operational. Customers should note that in-branch services are suspended on Sundays and specific regional holidays.

articles.title: NPS onboarding redesign, AI-powered pension advisory platform, NPS Swasthya—PFRDA Chair encourages ‘responsible’ AI use
articles.summary: PFRDA Chairman S Ramann outlined an AI roadmap to redesign the National Pension Scheme's onboarding process. He also encouraged ‘responsible’ AI use for a pension advisory platform powered by the technology.

articles.title: Foreign asset details for 2022-24 now available under AIS: What to do if you missed disclosing them in previous ITRs?
articles.summary: Taxpayers can now view their foreign assets and income via the AIS on the income tax e-filing portal. The AIS currently includes data for 2022-2024, with 2025 data expected by late 2026. Here's what to do if you missed disclosing them in previous ITRs.

articles.title: ITR filing 2026: FD interest is taxable — here's how to report it correctly
articles.summary: FD interest income is fully taxable but tax implications may vary based on the chosen tax regime and taxpayer age. Some deductions may also be available, based on your age and income profile. Here's all you need to know.

articles.title: Income-tax returns: Check penalty for missing deadline for filing ITR — Key things to know
articles.summary: ITR: Taxpayers must file their income-tax returns for FY26 / AY27 by 31 August this year, extended from 30 June. Here's how much penalty you can be charged and deadline for delayed ITR filing during the tax year.

articles.title: Berkshire has 30% of its portfolio in Apple, Alphabet: Expert says not ‘appropriate strategy’ for retail investors but…
articles.summary: Berkshire Hathaway now allocates nearly 30% of its $351 billion portfolio to Apple and Alphabet, reflecting a shift in Warren Buffett's investment strategy.

articles.title: EPFO: Here's how to link your Aadhaar with UAN using the Umang app — Stepwise guide
articles.summary: EPFO: Aadhaar linking is mandatory for several EPF services. Today, we check how EPF subscribers can link Aadhaar with their Universal Account Number (UAN) using the government's Umang mobile app.

articles.title: Claiming tax relief on salary arrears, advance pay or gratuity? Here's why Form 10e must be filed before ITR
articles.summary: Salary arrears and lump-sum payments can increase tax liability. Taxpayers must file Form 10E before their ITR to claim relief under Section 89 of the Income-tax Act. Here's what you need to know.

articles.title: 8th pay commission: Basic pay, allowances — components of salary structure in focus; Here's why
articles.summary: Around 50 lakh central government employees and about 65 lakh retired central government pensioners, including defence personnel and retirees, will benefit from the recommendations across 18 employee levels.

articles.title: Dearness Allowance: From DA hikes to pay arrears and other key announcements — Check latest updates, FAQ answers here
articles.summary: About 1 crore beneficiaries — close to 50 lakh central government employees and nearly 65 lakh retired central government pensioners, including defence personnel and retirees — will benefit from an increase in DA and DR.

articles.title: ITR filing 2026: If your tax liability is nil after Section 87A rebate, should you still file a return?
articles.summary: Even with a zero tax liability due to the Section 87A rebate, filing an income tax return (ITR) may be necessary. Your obligation to file depends on your total income and the tax regime you choose.

articles.title: IPO GMP Check: SBI Funds Management IPO vs Alpine Texworld IPO - What grey market signals ahead of listings?
articles.summary: SBI Funds Management and Alpine Texworld IPOs closed their bidding on July 16, with SBI commanding a GMP of ₹91 and being subscribed 41.66 times. Alpine Texworld had a GMP of ₹1 and was subscribed 1.40 times, indicating differing market performances ahead of their listings.

articles.title: ICICI Bank Q1 Results 2026: Net profit rises 16% to ₹14,804.50 crore
articles.summary: ICICI Bank reported a net profit of ₹14,804.50 crore for Q1 2026, reflecting a 16% increase from ₹12,768.21 crore in Q1 2025. The earnings announcement was made on July 18, 2026.

articles.title: Yes Bank Q1 results 2026: Net profit jumps 33.7% YoY, operating profit up 25.5%
articles.summary: Yes Bank Q1 results 2026: During the April to June 2026 period, Yes Bank reported net profit of ₹1,071 crore, up 33.7% Y-o-Y & 0.2% Q-o-Q

articles.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q1 Results 2026: Net profit rises 22.5% to ₹5,480 crore
articles.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 22.5% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, reaching ₹5,480.46 crore in Q1 FY27. Total income for the quarter rose to ₹30,068.60 crore, with standalone net profit at ₹4,122.96 crore.

articles.title: Axis Bank Q1 Results 2026: Net profit jumps 23% YoY to ₹7,114 crore; NII rises 8%
articles.summary: Axis Bank reported strong Q1 FY27 earnings, with standalone net profit rising 22.5% to ₹7,114 crore and net interest income growing over 8% to ₹14,646 crore, surpassing Street estimates.

articles.title: MakeMyTrip IPO soon! Online travel giant files confidential DRHP with SEBI, 15 years after Nasdaq listing
articles.summary: MakeMyTrip has initiated the process for its India IPO by filing a Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI. The offering involves an equity share sale by MakeMyTrip Limited and its subsidiary, ibibo Group, but details like the issue size remain undisclosed.

articles.title: Buy or sell: Sumeet Bagadia recommends three stocks to buy on Monday - 20 July 2026
articles.summary: Sumeet Bagadia of Choice Broking, highlighted that from a technical perspective, the index is now approaching the crucial resistance zone near 200-Day EMA, where a decisive breakout could trigger further upside momentum.

articles.title: Stocks to buy under ₹200: Mehul Kothari of Anand Rathi recommends three shares to buy or sell
articles.summary: Mehul Kothari from Anand Rathi suggests a cautious approach for traders, recommending a decisive close above 24,400 for a bullish outlook. For stocks under ₹200, he recommends Suzlon Energy, IDBI, and Zee Entertainment with specified buy prices and targets.

articles.title: Axis Bank Q1 preview: Profit, NII to stay healthy; NIM likely to shrink due to deposit repricing, competitive funding
articles.summary: As Axis Bank gears up to announce its Q1 results, analysts predict significant growth in net interest income and net profit. However, a potential decline in net interest margin due to competitive pressures and deposit repricing raises concerns.

articles.title: ICICI Bank Q1 results preview: Net profit seen up 3.1% YoY to ₹13,164 crore; NIMs, asset quality may remain stable
articles.summary: ICICI Bank Q1 results preview: ICICI Bank’s loan growth in the June quarter is expected to be healthy at 18.5% YoY, led by gold loans, corporate loans, personal loans and mortgages. Deposits are seen rising 15.2% YoY.

articles.title: HDFC Bank Q1 results preview: Net profit likely to rise 6% YoY on strong loan growth, NIMs to remain flat
articles.summary: HDFC Bank Q1 results preview: HDFC Bank Q1 results are expected to be mixed, with NIM likely to remain largely stable sequentially, while asset quality is expected to remain steady. Analysts anticipate healthy double-digit loan growth, supported by strong business momentum.

articles.summary: On July 18, over 20 companies, primarily banks, will announce their Q1 FY27 earnings, providing crucial insights into India's banking sector. Key indicators include profit growth and asset quality, with strong focus on management commentary amid rising geopolitical tensions.
